stemMd: The decomposition 2KClO₃ → 2KCl + 3O₂ occurs completely. How many moles of oxygen form from 0.40 mol of KClO₃?
explanationMd: The balanced equation gives three moles of oxygen per two moles of potassium chlorate. Multiply 0.40 by 3/2 to obtain 0.60 mol. The coefficients describe mole ratios, not equal quantities of every substance.

distractorRationale.e: This halves the amount instead of using the three-to-two ratio.
distractorRationale.c: This assumes a one-to-one ratio despite the coefficients.
distractorRationale.a: This multiplies by three but fails to divide by two.
distractorRationale.b: This uses a two-to-one ratio not present in the equation.
